record.paper_title: Twenty Open Questions in Supersymmetric Particle Physics
record.original_question: The MSSM contains many charged and colored scalar fields, not only Higgs fields, and its scalar potential has D-flat and F-flat directions along which charge- or color-breaking minima or unbounded-from-below behavior can arise. Why does the physical MSSM vacuum preserve QCD color and electromagnetic charge, what constraints on soft parameters are required, and if deeper charge- or color-breaking vacua exist, what cosmological history keeps the universe in the observed Standard-Model-like vacuum?

evidence.quote: Question #5 Why does the MSSM conserve color and charge?
In the MSSM there are a large number of charged and colored scalars in addition to the Higgs, any of which could receive a VEV and break the gauge group even further.
Then one finds two distinct types of problems which may arise: potentials which are charge- and color-breaking (CCB) at their minima, or potentials which are unbounded from below (UFB).
Thus the appropriate question raised by discovering violation of the CCB bounds may well be cosmological rather than directly experimental.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model (MSSM): a four-dimensional N=1 supersymmetric gauge theory with gauge group SU(3)_C × SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y, two Higgs doublet superfields H_u and H_d, three generations of quark and lepton chiral superfields, the MSSM superpotential with Yukawa couplings y_u, y_d, y_e and μ-term μ H_u H_d, and explicit soft supersymmetry-breaking terms consisting of scalar mass-squared matrices for all sfermions and Higgses, gaugino masses M_1, M_2, M_3, trilinear A-terms (A_u, A_d, A_e), and the bilinear Higgs soft term B μ.

The full tree-level scalar potential V(φ) on the space of all charged and colored scalar fields (squarks, sleptons, and Higgses) generically possesses:
(a) D-flat and F-flat directions along which V can become unbounded from below (UFB);
(b) charge- and/or color-breaking (CCB) stationary points at which squark or slepton VEVs are nonzero, possibly forming minima deeper than the standard electroweak-symmetry-breaking minimum in which only the neutral Higgs components acquire VEVs.

Address the following:

1. Determine necessary and sufficient analytic conditions on the soft-breaking parameters (sfermion mass-squareds, A-terms, gaugino masses, μ, B) such that the global minimum of V preserves SU(3)_C color and U(1)_em electric charge, i.e. such that no CCB minimum is deeper than the standard vacuum and V is bounded from below along all UFB directions.

2. Provide a theoretical explanation of why the physical MSSM vacuum realized in nature preserves color and electromagnetic charge.

3. In the case where the standard electroweak vacuum is only a local (metastable) minimum and deeper CCB or UFB regions exist, determine the cosmological conditions (thermal history, tunneling rates, inflationary initial conditions) under which the universe is dynamically selected into, and remains in, the standard-model-like vacuum on timescales longer than the age of the universe.
artifact.status_search_result: Analytic necessary/sufficient tree-level constraints on MSSM soft parameters from CCB and UFB directions have been derived (Casas–Lleyda–Muñoz and follow-ups in the 1990s), and post-Higgs-discovery analyses (e.g. JHEP 2014) have updated these bounds and incorporated metastability via vacuum tunneling rate computations. Thus the parameter-space constraint aspect is largely solved at the level of tree-plus-loop analyses, but the deeper conceptual question of why nature selects the color/charge-preserving vacuum and the full cosmological selection mechanism (including non-thermal initial conditions and inflationary history) remains open.

status_evidence.title: Strong Constraints on the Parameter Space of the MSSM from Charge and Color Breaking Minima
status_evidence.snippet: Necessary and sufficient analytic conditions on MSSM soft parameters to avoid CCB minima and UFB directions are derived.
status_evidence.claim: Analytic constraints on soft parameters are known.

status_evidence.title: Phase transitions and vacuum tunneling into charge- and color-breaking minima in the MSSM
status_evidence.snippet: Even if the true vacuum breaks charge and color, the universe may sit in a metastable standard minimum; tunneling stability gives further constraints.
status_evidence.claim: Cosmological metastability has been studied and constrains parameters.

status_evidence.title: Charge and color breaking constraints in MSSM after the Higgs discovery at LHC
status_evidence.snippet: Post-125 GeV Higgs reanalysis of CCB/UFB constraints, particularly on A_t and stop mixing.
status_evidence.claim: Constraints remain actively refined; question is not fully closed.
